title: Creating render pipeline for a `RDShaderFile` that doesn't have vertex shader causes crash
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.rc3

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc.mono - EndeavourOS  SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 22 Feb 2025 00:37:05 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV RENOIR) - AMD Ryzen 7 4800U with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

If a glsl file only has `#[fragment]` but no `#[vertex]`, it can be successfully compiled and loaded in script. And if it is used in `RenderingDevice.render_pipeline_create`, the game will crash (if it's a tool script, the whole editor will crash).

### Steps to reproduce

Run the MRP, then the game crashes:
```
Stop reason: signal SIGSEGV: address not mapped to object (fault address: 0x0)
Stop reason: signal SIGSEGV: invalid permissions for mapped object (fault address: 0x7fffa7e21fd0)
```
